lesson_card.plain_english: who can approve, access, trigger, delete, escalate, or spend when an AI agent starts acting
lesson_card.big_question: Is the product the agent, or the power to decide what the agent is allowed to do?
lesson_card.simple_analogy: the remote control for what an AI agent is allowed to touch, approve, buy, or break
lesson_card.common_misunderstanding: People focus on the launch. The useful question is who gains control, who inherits risk, and what changes tomorrow.
lesson_card.listener_payoff: By the end, listeners should understand permission layer well enough to explain why today's AI story matters tomorrow.
lesson_card.operator_lesson: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.
lesson_card.episode_spine: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO, and Board Director is really about who controls what agents are allowed to do.

turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: The executive vacuum is closed. The market had a week of pricing in various worst cases. The reinstatement resets the baseline.

turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: And the investigation becomes the thing to watch. Not because we know it'll produce a damaging finding, but because it's unresolved and it involves the same circumstances that caused a brief but real leadership crisis at the most important company in AI hardware.

turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: The question the press release doesn't answer — and can't answer right now — is whether Huang's return means the scandal is behind NVIDIA, or whether the investigation is a clock that's still running.
